title: FORCEMARCH_DRYRUN_RUN157_ZERO_FINDS_BLIND_SPOT

blind_spot.issue: forcemarch scanned ONLY 6 zones with a narrow regex (SOUL=^> ", GAP=MISSING|GAP|TODO.*recover|FIXME.*restore). It found 0 — but that is NOT clean ground.
blind_spot.scout_comparison: phoenix-scout (earlier this session) scanned CANON/ broadly and found 17934: 14128 SOUL, 3059 GAP, 447 DRIFT, 260 LEDGER, 36 PIPELINE. forcemarch's zone list EXCLUDES CANON/SYSTEM, CANON/SOUL/EXTRACT, CANON/SOUL/BIBLE — exactly where the real gaps live.
blind_spot.verdict: forcemarch 0-finds is a blind spot, not a clean bill. The march is looking in 6 buckets while the colony's gaps are in 3 others it never opens.

bug.problem: $lastNum is never defined (script uses $lastDeath, $gitRun, $currentRun). Non-dry-run execution throws here, blocking the mandatory recovery-phetrail generation loop.
bug.fix: Replace $lastNum with $gitRun (or $currentRun-1) to iterate 1..$gitRun for missing-run recovery phetrails.

negative_trails.failure: forcemarch scans 6 zones, misses CANON/SYSTEM + CANON/SOUL/EXTRACT + CANON/SOUL/BIBLE where 17934 gaps actually live.
negative_trails.root_cause: Hard-coded narrow zone list + narrow regex. Doesn't match phoenix-scout's broad CANON/ sweep.

negative_trails.failure: Non-dry-run forcemarch throws at $lastNum (undefined) — cannot generate mandatory phetrails.
negative_trails.root_cause: Typo: $lastNum never assigned. Blocks the recovery-phetrail loop (lines 61-69).

positive_trails.action: forcemarch.ps1 is confirmed LOCAL-ONLY (no D1, no Cloudflare, no PCC). The Run 145 'FORBIDDEN' flag was stale/incorrect.
positive_trails.verification: Read SCRIPTS/forcemarch.ps1 — only filesystem + git, no external calls.

next: To make the march real: (1) widen zones to include CANON/SYSTEM, CANON/SOUL/EXTRACT, CANON/SOUL/BIBLE; (2) fix $lastNum bug; (3) re-run without --dry-run to generate recovery phetrails. Awaiting operator go-ahead (or fix-authorized).
